headline: Greece's population programme expanded to 10 more regions, households to receive 10,000 euros
summary: Greek government spokesperson Pavlos Marinakis said the Population Development Programme is being extended to 10 more regions. Households are to receive €10,000.
why: Fiscal transfer programmes add to public spending and can affect demographic and labour-market trends over time.
